snippet.title: Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection | Animated Trailer
snippet.description:
Pre-order Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection now.
https://www.monsterhunter.com/stories3/en-us/products/

Check out this new and original animated trailer, set before the events of Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection!
(Production: SHIN-EI ANIMATION, Production Support: CAPCOM)

Your story begins March 13, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC/Steam.
  
Download the free demo and carry your save data over to the full game.
https://www.monsterhunter.com/stories3/en-us/trial/
